question: Where can I find a park that are within 30 kilometers and lie east of Dwarfskill Preserve, Milford, PA?
sql: WITH source_location AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Dwarfskill Preserve%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Milford%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%PA%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT P.park_name FROM parks AS P, source_location AS SL WHERE ST_DWithin(P.geometry::geography, SL.geometry::geography, 30000) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(SL.geometry, ST_Centroid(P.geometry))) BETWEEN 67.5 AND 112.5;
